verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes Rootly only as a hosted platform reached through its web app, Slack/Teams, API and mobile app, and never mentions a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The MCP server exposes Rootly data to MCP clients but is not the core product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
